title: Asahel
summary: Raleigh names Asahel in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Asahel, also printed Asabel, the brother of Ioab, whom Abner slewe in the pursuit during the warre for Isboseth. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. II, sig. 293b
